subject: Midnight Club
author: thephilofwar
body:
Those who have been saying that this upcoming Burnout game is most comparable to TDU are wrong. From the article I just read, I'm gathering that it is a LOT like Midnight Club....no laps? You must find your own way from point A to B? This type of racing combined with the free roam element is exactly like Midnight Club 3, and I don't like that. I like Burnout.....not Midnight Club, and this is a HUGE departure from the norm of the Burnout series 😏

__________

This is the truth that I am revealing before you! Behold; those who hear me now, have got ears to hear from!
